headline: Going Commando replaces its generated-source workflow and imports library C
summary: Going Commando removes the old campaign, proof and generated-source system and documents a replacement layout using ordinary source files. The large deletion count is dominated by retired generated units, catalogues, scripts and reports. SDK and library C is carried over from Ratchet & Clank, and the repository adopts GPL-3.0 while retaining earlier notices.
highlights: A measured table preserves ambiguous pairings between boot functions and repeated level copies.
The transferred library code covers MPEG, kernel, C-library, IPU and SIF families. No new overall coverage report is available for this day.
